comoFunciona.entradilla: You buy a product, pay the published price from a US bank, and designate where it should be delivered. We buy that merchandise from the supplier in our own name and sell it to you, with an invoice.

queEs.texto: Mercatren is an online store operated by «SOCIEDAD» («ESTADO», United States). We sell products for our own account: we buy the merchandise from the supplier in our name and resell it to you. The price you see published is the final price and includes our commercial markup.
puntos: The buyer is in the United States and pays from a US bank.
The published price is the final price: nothing is added afterward.
«SOCIEDAD» buys the merchandise from the supplier, invoiced in its name.
The product is delivered to the address the buyer designates.
Every transaction leaves a purchase invoice, a sales invoice, and proof of delivery.

lista.titulo: Choose the product from the catalog
lista.texto: On confirmation, the system re-reads price and availability from the database. The total comes from that reading.

lista.titulo: Pay the published price from a US bank
lista.texto: By card or bank transfer. Only payments originating from US banks are accepted.
You designate where the product must be delivered and are responsible for the address being correct.

lista.titulo: Get your invoice and track the order
lista.texto: You receive the sales invoice in your name and can follow the order through to delivery.

paraComercios.titulo: For merchants that publish a catalog
paraComercios.texto: You publish your catalog and your prices. When a sale happens, Mercatren buys the merchandise from you and you ship to the designated address. You are paid for the merchandise purchased against your invoice, to a US bank account.
puntos: You publish your catalog and the price you sell to us at.
When a sale happens, Mercatren buys that merchandise from you.
You ship the product to the address designated on the order.
You are paid for the merchandise purchased against your invoice.
Not a financial institution: we do not offer accounts and we do not hold anyone's money.
We do not deliver money to any person: we deliver products.
We do not exchange currency: buying and selling happen in US dollars.
We do not act as a representative of any party.
We are not a bank and we do not extend credit.

pagos.texto: Only payments originating from US banks are accepted. The published price is the same whichever method you choose: picking one over another does not change what you pay.

metodos.texto: Processed through a registered payment processor. It is the primary method for the service, for convenience and because it leaves the cleanest documentary trail.
Available for purchases from $200. A member of our team checks the payment against the bank before an order is treated as valid.

transparencia.entradilla: This page describes our operation for banks, payment processors, partners, and anyone who needs to understand exactly what we do and what we do not.

quienes.texto: Mercatren is a service operated by «SOCIEDAD» («ESTADO», United States). We sell products for our own account to buyers residing in the United States: we buy the merchandise from the supplier in the name of «SOCIEDAD» and resell it to the buyer, who designates the address where it must be delivered.

noSomos.titulo: First, so there is no doubt
noSomos.texto: Mercatren is not a financial institution, does not offer accounts, does not maintain user balances, and does not carry out money transfers. Every transaction is a sale of goods between the buyer and «SOCIEDAD».

flujo.texto: One path, always the same, and always documented:
pasos: The buyer, located in the United States, purchases a product and pays the published price to «SOCIEDAD» from a US bank.
«SOCIEDAD» records the order with its number, amount, date, products, and the delivery address designated by the buyer.
A member of our team verifies that the payment originates from a US bank and that the amount matches. Only then is the order treated as valid.
«SOCIEDAD» buys the merchandise sold from the supplier, in its own name, and the supplier issues an invoice to «SOCIEDAD».
The supplier delivers the product to the designated address and the delivery is recorded.
«SOCIEDAD» issues the sales invoice to the buyer and closes the order.

limites.titulo: What the operation does not include
puntos: No money is delivered to any person, at any destination: products are delivered.
No accounts are offered and no user balances are maintained.
No money belonging to third parties is received or administered.
No currency exchange takes place: we operate only in US dollars.
No credit or banking services are offered.

prohibidos.texto: The following are never listed or sold:
puntos: Weapons, ammunition, and explosives.
Medicines, controlled substances, and restricted-use products.
Items subject to export controls.
Live animals.
Currency, monetary metals, gift cards, crypto assets, and financial instruments.
Goods of unlawful origin or that infringe third-party rights.
Any order whose buyer or delivery address corresponds to persons or destinations subject to US sanctions.
Buying requires an account with a verified email; the order is tied to that account.
Only payments originating from US banks are accepted.
No bank transfer is credited on its own: a person checks it against the bank before approving it.
Rejected payments are recorded with the reason for rejection.
Whoever sells does not approve their own incoming payments: a supplier cannot approve payments on its own orders.

registros.titulo: What is recorded for every transaction
puntos: Order number, date, products, unit price, and total, in US dollars.
Buyer's account and the designated delivery address.
Method, date, and amount of the payment received, with its record.
Purchase invoice issued by the supplier to «SOCIEDAD».
Sales invoice issued by «SOCIEDAD» to the buyer.
Proof of delivery, and who approved each step and when.

comisiones.texto: The supplier sells us the merchandise at its price. The price at which «SOCIEDAD» resells it to the buyer is set and published by us, and it includes our commercial markup. The published price is the final price: nothing is added afterward.
comisiones.nota: Our earnings are the difference between the purchase price and the sale price of our own product, not a charge applied to someone else's money.

retencion.texto: Every transaction keeps its documents for five years: the order, the record of the payment received, the purchase invoice, the sales invoice, and the proof of delivery.

contacto.texto: If you represent a bank, a payment processor, or a business partner and need additional documentation about the operation, write to us.

transparencia.avisoLegal: This page describes how the operation works in practice. It does not constitute legal or tax advice, and it does not replace the service's terms and conditions.

diccionario.porQueTexto: The site was written as an agency that collects and hands over other people's money. That is, word for word, the definition of money transmission in the United States, and it is why banks close accounts. The whole site was corrected on August 5, 2026; this page exists so we don't undo it by talking.
